title: Model zones, physical roads and access
caption: The accepted 25-zone circle and 5,138 directed OSM physical traversal arcs, with 25 in-zone road-entry points. The full turn-expanded graph has 14,203 arcs; turn arcs are not additional roads. EPSG:26917 coordinates are displayed relative to the study-area center in km. This is the accepted four-stage graph, not the earlier 4,059-link centerline preflight. © OpenStreetMap contributors, ODbL 1.0. Local reading revision.
